publications.title: Unified Law for Visual Tasks (The Four Laws of Computer Vision)

highlight.text: **Order-of-magnitude width + Concept breakthrough:** Propose [WSM](https://github.com/World-Snapshot/StreamFlow) and [Unified Law for Visual Tasks](https://github.com/World-Snapshot/Unified-Law-for-Visual-Tasks) (The Four Laws of Computer Vision), which supports thousands more tasks than existing computer vision models and can create over 40 million<fn>Assuming at least 80 visual modalities and allowing any modality at each of the four positions in a three-step task, the number of possible task combinations is 80⁴ = 40,960,000. Because the output of one task can become the input of another, longer task chains continue to expand this number.</fn> new computer vision tasks, with virtually unlimited room to grow<fn>Of course, these changes developed quietly like raindrops. LLM can do countless things, but no one has detailed its capabilities. The capabilities of WSM will not be divided either; it can perform all tasks related to vision and the world.</fn>.

publications.title: Stable Signer: Hierarchical Sign Language Generative Model
publications.publication:
ICCV 2025 Demo Track, Honolulu, Hawaii, USA; and ACL 2026 Main Conference (Oral), San Diego, California, USA
ACL 2026 Best Paper Award Nominee (out of 12,148 submissions)

highlight.text: **Significant performance breakthrough:** Outperforms contemporary state-of-the-art generation methods by 48.6%.

publications.title: Stable Signer V3: 4D Deformable Primitive Splatting Is All You Need for Sign Language Production

highlight.text: **High-resolution avatar breakthrough:** Introduces 4D Deformable Primitive Splatting for interactive sign language avatars, reducing facial geometry error by 71.4%, body-boundary error by 35.1%, and high-resolution RGB reconstruction error by 24.2%, while retaining interactive streaming.
**Concept breakthrough:** Make the reconstruction task a condition generation task; Make the decoder the encoder; Make the single-step decoding and encoding a multi-step decoding and encoding.

publications.title: StreamFlow: Theory, Algorithm, and Implementation for High-Efficiency Rectified Flow Generation

highlight.text: **Order-of-magnitude performance breakthrough:** The generation speed of Rectified Flow has been accelerated up to 611%, while the universal training-free Flow acceleration methods during the same period only increased by 18% or 30%.

publications.title: SignVerse-2M: A Two-Million-Clip Pose-Native Universe of 55+ Sign Languages

highlight.text: **Dataset breakthrough:** Make sign language research practical, affordable, and scalable!

publications.title: SignX: Continuous Sign Recognition in Compact Pose-Rich Latent Space

highlight.text: **Performance breakthrough:** 2026 CSLR SOTA. The recognition and understanding tasks on any sign language dataset can/will achieve state-of-the-art results. Let Pose Recognition Happen in Latent Space, as well!

publications.title: SignLLM: Sign Language Production Large Language Models

highlight.text: **Order-of-magnitude width breakthrough:** The single model supports the generation of 8 types of sign languages, and the number of SLP tasks it supports has increased by eight times.

publications.note: This work was reported by hundreds of media outlets and was viewed by tens of millions of people, and received an exclusive interview by [New Scientist](https://www.newscientist.com/) (5M+ followers).
